coordinates.note: JSON uses Blender coordinates; obstacle center.z is relative to its deck_reference_z. center_absolute retains model-space bounds.

stair_connections.run_note: Legacy run is total horizontal run; step_run is 0.25 m.

fore_well.clearance_note: Subtract oriented obstacle boxes and deck_holes. Hatches and mast retained; companion doorway remains open.
fore_well.stairs_collision_note: Stair boxes are envelopes: use traversable bottom/top/width ramps and handrails, never a solid envelope collider.

superstructure_t2.extent_note: T2 house 0.485–0.792; exposed T1 roof includes both cross-deck landings.

boat_deck.extent_note: Main paths stop at |y|=6.20 behind boats; two forward bridge-wing landings cover x=0.40..4.8399, |y|=4.64..6.82. Narrow dead strips behind the wing columns are not walkable.

excluded_clearance_pockets.reason: Behind wing column, between expanded stair aperture and outer deck edge; no 0.30 m clearance route to a landing.
Behind wing column, between expanded stair aperture and outer deck edge; no 0.30 m clearance route to a landing.

connections.run_note: Legacy run is total horizontal run; step_run is 0.25 m.

galley_block.allowed: Only the front/starboard shell <= 0.04 m and roof.

hold.allowed: The deck underside may serve as the hold ceiling.

nav_check.method: segment arrangement / vertical trapezoid decomposition; no grid approximation
nav_check.obstacle_offset: 0.30 m on each side in box-local XY; conservative square offset
nav_check.edge_clearance: Closed rail/wall edges use 0.10 m wide segment boxes, also expanded by 0.30 m; open edges produce no barrier.
nav_check.boundary_note: Walkable outlines inset 0.33 m from hull shell; deck holes offset by the same 0.30 m agent margin. Stair links use clear deck landings.
nav_check.overhead_rule: Only obstacle boxes intersecting [deck-0.05, deck+1.75] block walking.
nav_check.step_rule: Boxes whose top is <= 0.30 m above deck are step-over colliders (PlayerBuilder.cs).
nav_check.stair_rule: Stair envelopes are traversable links, never solid nav blockers.

layout_adjustments.reason: 1.75 m player headroom; same X/Y, boom tips and ship bounds.
Clear rear center passage after 0.30 m obstacle expansion; preserve access to poop stairs.

collision_rules.edges: closed polylines produce rail/wall colliders; open=true produces no barrier
collision_rules.shared_obstacles: Deduplicate globally by id; shared_from marks boxes exposed at adjacent deck boundaries.
collision_rules.deck_holes: Subtract these inner loops from walkable_polygons when building floor colliders; nav offsets them by 0.30 m.
collision_rules.stairs: replace stair envelope boxes with traversable connections
collision_rules.integration: ShipDeck.cs currently uses hard-coded fore_well colliders; loading v2 is a separate Unity change.
